label: Task branch naming and main-use policy
description: Defines the boring Git branch model for multi-machine Eureka work.
main_exceptions: repo sync guard task with clean tree

branch_rules.sync: sync, merge, rescue, or guard control branch

required_start_state: no merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or revert state
new task branch created from current main
required_finish_state: main not updated by the task machine unless it is the integration machine
forbidden_normal_operations: parallel task work directly on main
hiding local-only branch piles across machines
notes: Branch naming mismatches are advisory unless the operator selects strict mode.
Integration merges happen on one machine only.
